Compare a first-time viewer's understanding of a promo clip with the truth.
TRUTH (from the show bible, for episodes E11): Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Mayor Brisk (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14
Selene (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 46 lines between E1 and E14
Widow Halloran (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14
Tobin The Ferryman (a man in period dress): [mock] speaks 40 lines between E1 and E14
Arc [mock] Part 4: A storm traps the whole family in the lighthouse overnight.
E11: Selene's betrothed confesses that he planted the ring.
CLIP: [On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
[Action: the figure in period dress kneels on the slick quay boards.]
a figure in period dress: "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the figure in period dress and the man in period dress, the space between them charged.]
a man in period dress (off-screen): "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
[On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
a figure in period dress: "Mother will see you hang for this."
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the man in period dress and the figure in period dress, the space between them charged.]
[Action: the man in period dress slaps the cup from the figure in period dress's hand and it shatters.]
a figure in period dress: "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
a figure in period dress: "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
[On screen: Close-up on the widow's jaw tightening.]
[On screen: Low angle on the figure in period dress framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a man in period dress: "Your father paid me to watch over you."
[On screen: High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.]
a man in period dress: "Your father paid me to watch over you."
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
a figure in period dress: "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
[On screen: Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
